Authentic sports photography of a Kenyan distance runner crossing the Olympic finish line, arms raised in triumph. Camera at track level, 4 meters from finish, angled slightly upward, telephoto compressing the stadium — exactly how an accredited photographer captures this moment.

The athlete is female, mid-20s, Kenyan, her face showing specific exhaustion of a 10,000-meter race — not a pretty cry but real athletic distress transformed into joy. Dark brown skin with visible red and purple undertones from extreme exertion, sweat running in rivulets down temples and neck. Real texture: visible pores across nose and forehead, slight roughness from Rift Valley training sun, small old scar near hairline, chapped lips from mouth-breathing. Expression is raw — mouth open gulping air, eyes scrunched with tears and effort, grimace-smile of crossing first. Not beautiful, transcendent.

Her body shows elite East African distance runner physique: extremely lean, almost gaunt, visible clavicles, ropy musculature. Arms raised imperfectly — one higher than other, fingers spread unevenly, genuine emotion not rehearsed. Red and green Kenyan singlet dark with sweat, race number pinned crooked, one safety pin loose. Legs show race wear: dried salt, track dust, visible tendons.

Stadium captured through sports photography conventions: crowd a blur of color, camera flashes as circular bokeh, flags as colorful smears, Olympic rings out of focus. Other runners behind — one bent over, another still finishing.

The lighting is realistic stadium arrays — multiple overheads for broadcast, no single dramatic key. Afternoon sun adds warm fill mixing with cooler stadium lights.

Camera style: Canon EOS-1D X Mark III with 400mm f/2.8 at f/3.2, exactly what Getty photographers use. Shutter 1/1600s with slight motion blur in raised hands. Telephoto compression flattens crowd.

Color grading: Minimal editorial sports adjustment — accurate stadium colors, true skin tones, Kenya's red and green. Wire service standard post.

Composition: Athlete at left third crossing visible finish line. Finish camera gantry enters from top. Crowd fills background. Aspect ratio 3:2.

Mood & vibe: Authentic triumph, documentary sports photography. The actual AP photo that appears in newspapers.

Quality: 8K, extreme detail in skin texture, sweat, pores, salt residue, muscular definition, fabric, crowd bokeh.

Negative prompts: No smooth skin, no perfect tears, no glamour lighting, no model physique, no clean uniform, no perfect pose, no CGI crowd, no retouched face.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Anuncio Comercial)
prompts.text:
A UFC fighter posed as a Renaissance oil painting in the style of Caravaggio, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting revealing a warrior's body against pure black void. Camera simulates the viewing angle of a museum visitor, straight-on at eye level, the figure rendered as if on a 2-meter tall canvas.

The fighter is male, late 20s, mixed ethnicity, captured in a classical contrapposto pose — weight on back leg, torso turned, head looking over shoulder into the darkness. His body shows the specific physique of a professional fighter: functional muscle definition, visible vascularity, the scars and wear of competition. His hands are wrapped in traditional white tape, knuckles showing healed cuts and calcium deposits. His face is battle-worn but noble: a small scar through one eyebrow, slightly cauliflowered ear, a nose that's been broken, but expression showing dignity and quiet strength. His skin shows the texture of a warrior — not smooth, but lived in.

The rendering mimics oil painting: visible brushstroke texture throughout, the specific way oil paint captures skin tones with underpainting showing through, the almost luminous quality of Renaissance flesh rendering. Craquelure aging effects — tiny networked cracks in the paint surface — are visible, suggesting this is an old master work. The edge of an ornate gilded frame is visible at the extreme edges of the composition.

The background is Caravaggio's signature: pure black void, the figure emerging from total darkness with no environmental context, all attention on the human form.

The lighting is single-source dramatic chiaroscuro — strong directional light from upper left illuminating the torso, face, and wrapped hands while everything else falls into deep shadow. The light appears to be candlelight or oil lamp: warm, flickering quality implied in the rendering. At least 60% of the figure is in shadow, with the light dramatically sculpting musculature.

Camera style: This should appear to be a high-resolution photograph of an oil painting hanging in a museum — not a photograph of a person. The texture of canvas weave is subtly visible. The "lens" is documenting artwork, not creating it.

Color grading: Old master palette — rich warm browns, deep ochres, cream highlights on skin, the specific limited palette of Renaissance painting before modern pigments. Varnish yellowing adds an aged quality to the overall tonality.

Composition: Figure positioned according to classical proportions, occupying the central two-thirds of the vertical frame. The contrapposto creates diagonal energy. Hands are positioned prominently, given their importance to the fighter's identity.

Mood & vibe: Timeless warrior nobility, classical meets contemporary, sport as art. Feels like a discovered masterpiece in a European museum — "Unknown Fighter, School of Caravaggio, c. 1605."

Quality: 8K resolution, extreme detail in brushstroke texture, craquelure patterns, skin rendering, gilded frame detail, canvas weave.

Negative prompts: No photograph of a real person, no modern background, no MMA gear, no octagon, no gloves, no bright colors, no flat lighting, no digital rendering, no smooth textures.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Anuncio Comercial)
prompts.text:
Extreme close-up of a deconstructed lemon tart at a three-Michelin-star restaurant, capturing the precision and artistry of high-end gastronomy. Camera positioned at 45-degree overhead angle, 30cm from plate, macro lens isolating the dish against the blurred white tablecloth.

The dish is architectural: a perfect quenelle of yuzu curd with visible citrus oil sheen, positioned beside shattered sugar work that catches light like amber glass, micro-dots of lemon gel placed with surgical precision, edible flowers (micro violas and borage) adding color accents, gold leaf fragments catching light, a swoosh of passion fruit coulis painted across the white ceramic. Crumbs of brown butter shortbread provide textural contrast. Condensation is visible on the cool curd, suggesting it just arrived at the table. Every element is intentional — this is food as art.

The plate itself is a design object: matte white ceramic with an organic asymmetrical shape, the kind of custom piece commissioned specifically for this dish. A silver dessert fork enters frame at edge, suggesting the moment before first bite.

The environment is implied through blur: white tablecloth with subtle texture, the edge of a wine glass with golden dessert wine, soft candlelight bokeh in the distance suggesting the intimate restaurant setting.

The lighting is soft directional key light from upper left, creating gentle shadows that provide dimension without harshness. The light is designed for food photography — it makes the curd glisten, the sugar work sparkle, and the sauce shine.

Camera style: Phase One IQ4 150MP medium format with 120mm macro at f/4, focus-stacked for acceptable sharpness across the entire dish while maintaining some depth falloff. The resolution captures every texture — the sheen on the curd, the crystal structure of the sugar, the vein pattern in the edible flowers.

Color grading: Clean, natural, appetizing — whites are pure, yellows of the citrus elements pop without oversaturation, greens of herbs are fresh. Food & Wine magazine cover quality — enhanced for appetite appeal but still believable.

Composition: Dish fills frame according to rule of thirds, with the quenelle at power point. Sugar work creates visual interest at opposite side. Negative space in the blurred background prevents claustrophobia.

Mood & vibe: Aspirational, precise, delicious. Feels like Michelin Guide documentation or a fine dining magazine spread.

Quality: 8K, extreme detail in every element — curd texture, sugar crystal structure, gold leaf wrinkles, sauce viscosity, ceramic glaze.

Negative prompts: No cartoon, no CGI, no fast food, no messy plating, no dark moody lighting, no overhead flat shot, no busy background, no plastic dishware, no artificial-looking food.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Anuncio Comercial)
prompts.text:
Environmental portrait of a weathered Icelandic fisherman standing at the bow of his boat at 4 AM during midnight sun. Camera at eye level, 2 meters from subject, shooting with moderate telephoto to compress the fjord landscape behind him.

The fisherman is in his late 60s, his face a roadmap of life at sea: deep wrinkles carved by decades of wind and salt, weathered ruddy complexion, pale blue eyes squinting against the horizon, grey stubble of several days, thinning grey hair beneath a worn wool cap. He wears a classic yellow oilskin rain slicker, faded and patched from years of use, the material showing water droplets from sea spray. His hands, visible gripping the boat rail, are thick-fingered and scarred — working hands. His expression is calm, watchful, reading the sea.

The Icelandic environment tells the story: misty fjord waters stretching behind him with steep mountain walls rising on both sides, snow visible on peaks even in summer, low clouds clinging to mountainsides. The midnight sun casts an ethereal soft glow — not true daylight but that surreal luminous quality of northern summer nights. Sea birds are visible as distant specks.

The lighting is the magical midnight sun — a soft, directionless luminosity that creates minimal shadows and that specific flat but glowing quality unique to Arctic summer. The light is cool but warm simultaneously — blue ambient with golden direct light from sun near horizon.

Camera style: Nikon Z9 with 85mm f/1.4 at f/2.0, creating shallow depth of field that keeps the face sharp while the fjord behind falls into creamy bokeh. The rendering has that Nikon characteristic — excellent color and skin tones.

Color grading: Muted natural tones — the specific blue-grey-green of Icelandic landscape, yellow of the slicker providing color pop, authentic weathered skin tones. Steve McCurry meets National Geographic documentary aesthetic.

Composition: Fisherman positioned at right third, boat bow leading into frame from bottom left, fjord landscape occupying left two-thirds as context. Horizon at upper third.

Mood & vibe: Timeless, dignified, connection to nature and tradition. Feels like National Geographic or a documentary about disappearing ways of life.

Quality: 8K, extreme detail in facial texture, fabric weathering, water droplets, distant landscape despite bokeh.

Negative prompts: No cartoon, no CGI, no young subject, no clean new clothing, no harsh sunlight, no tropical location, no posed smile, no modern commercial fishing vessel.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Fitness Activo)
prompts.text:
Dynamic action shot of a skateboarder mid-kickflip at a Venice Beach skatepark at sunset. Camera positioned at ground level, shooting upward, 2 meters from subject, capturing both the frozen trick and the dramatic backlit sky.

The skater is male, early 20s, Latino, captured at the apex of a kickflip — the board frozen mid-rotation beneath his feet, separated by 15 centimeters, visible griptape and deck graphic spinning. His body shows the specific posture of this trick: knees bent preparing to catch, arms out for balance, eyes locked on the board. He wears a worn vintage t-shirt, loose jeans rolled at ankle, classic Vans. His face shows pure concentration. Tiny details: scratched knuckles, tattoos on forearms, sweat droplets suspended around him.

The Venice Beach environment provides context: concrete bowl and ramp edges visible, palm trees silhouetted against sky, other skaters blurred in motion in background, iconic Venice Beach architecture in far distance. The California skate culture aesthetic.

The lighting is dramatic golden hour backlighting — sun setting directly behind the skater, creating a strong silhouette effect with bright rim lighting around his entire figure. Long shadows stretch toward camera. The sky shows sunset gradient from golden yellow to deep orange to purple.

Camera style: Canon EOS-1D X Mark III with 35mm f/1.4 at f/2.8, shot from low angle. Shutter speed 1/4000s freezing all motion completely — board, sweat, dust particles. Focus on the board gap between feet.

Color grading: Gritty street photography with golden hour warmth — crushed blacks in shadows creating silhouette, warm golden tones in highlights, slightly desaturated midtones. Professional sports meets street documentation aesthetic.

Composition: Skater and board at frame center, elevated against sky. Ground level creates dramatic upward perspective. Palm trees at frame edges provide environment.

Mood & vibe: Youthful energy, California cool, athletic grace. Feels like a Thrasher Magazine cover or Nike SB campaign.

Quality: 8K, extreme detail in frozen motion — board graphics, shoe soles, sweat droplets, fabric movement.

Negative prompts: No cartoon, no CGI, no motion blur on subject, no indoor skatepark, no competition setting, no helmet (keeping authentic street skating aesthetic), no midday flat lighting.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Fitness Activo)
prompts.text:
Black and white documentary photograph of an aging boxer training alone in a run-down neighborhood gym. Camera positioned at hip height, shooting slightly upward, 3 meters from subject, capturing both the boxer and the environmental storytelling of the gym.

The boxer is male, late 50s, African American, past his prime but still training. He's mid-punch against a worn heavy bag, body showing the muscle memory of thousands of hours. His face is weathered with old scar tissue around his eyebrows, a nose broken multiple times, hands wrapped in tape that's beginning to unravel. He wears a grey hoodie with cut-off sleeves and worn sweatpants. His expression is pure focus — this is meditation, not competition.

The gym is a character itself: run-down with visible water stains on ceiling tiles, dirty windows with light streaming through, faded posters of Ali, Frazier, and Leonard peeling from the walls, worn equipment patched with tape. Dust particles float in the light shafts. A speed bag hangs motionless in background. No one else is present — this is early morning solitude.

The lighting is pure available light — dirty windows providing soft directional light from frame left, creating strong shadows and beautiful falloff. Dust particles catch the light rays. No flash, no studio equipment.

Camera style: Shot on Leica M10 Monochrom with 35mm f/2 Summicron at f/4, slightly wide angle but not distorted. The image has that specific Leica rendering — micro-contrast, beautiful tonal graduation, sharp but not clinical.

Color grading: Black and white with rich full-range tonality — deep blacks that aren't crushed, bright highlights that aren't blown, beautiful midtones with information. Henri Cartier-Bresson meets Gordon Parks aesthetic.

Composition: Boxer positioned at left third, heavy bag at center, environmental context filling right side. Light source (window) visible at frame edge. Leading lines from gym equipment draw to subject.

Mood & vibe: Solitary dignity, quiet determination, blue-collar beauty. Feels like a Magnum Photos essay or documentary still.

Quality: 8K monochrome, extreme detail in textures — skin, fabric, leather bag, peeling posters, dust particles.

Negative prompts: No color, no modern gym, no other people, no bright lighting, no clean environment, no young athlete, no posed portrait, no action movie aesthetic.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Belleza & Glow)
prompts.text:
High-fashion editorial shot of a model in a flowing crimson silk gown on cracked desert earth at magic hour. Camera at eye level, 10 meters distance, slightly low angle to elongate figure against dramatic sky, medium telephoto for compression and separation.

The model is late 20s, angular bone structure, standing in a power pose with weight on back leg, chin raised. The crimson silk gown is haute couture — dramatic sweeping train extending 3 meters behind, fabric catching wind and creating sculptural shapes. The material shows beautiful texture: light catching silk threads, subtle sheen variations as fabric folds. Her makeup is editorial bold: strong contoured cheekbones, dramatic smoky eye, matte burgundy lip. Hair pulled back severely in a low chignon. Expression is defiant and powerful — this is fashion as armor.

The desert landscape is stark beauty: cracked dry earth in hexagonal patterns extending to horizon, texture visible in each dried mud tile. A dust storm approaches in far background, creating apocalyptic amber-ochre sky gradient. No vegetation, no structures — pure minimalist void emphasizing the figure.

The lighting is pure magic hour — sun 10 degrees above horizon, warm amber-gold directional light from frame right, casting long shadows and illuminating the crimson silk to almost glow. The approaching dust storm diffuses the light slightly, creating softer gradients. Rim light separates the figure from background.

Camera style: Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format with 150mm at f/4, shallow depth of field isolating figure from landscape. Resolution and tonal range of medium format digital.

Color grading: Muted warm tones with pops of saturated crimson — desaturated background earth tones, amber sky, the gown as sole color punch. Vogue Italia editorial aesthetic, painterly quality.

Composition: Model at right third, gown train extending left. Horizon at lower third, sky dominating upper frame. Dust storm provides background texture without distraction.

Mood & vibe: Powerful, apocalyptic beauty, fashion as statement. Feels like the cover of Vogue or a Valentino campaign.

Quality: 8K medium format resolution, extreme detail in fabric texture, skin, cracked earth pattern, atmospheric effects.

Negative prompts: No cartoon, no CGI, no casual clothing, no smile, no flat lighting, no midday sun, no green vegetation, no cluttered background, no Instagram filter look.

prompts.title: Espejo Baño Rutina Mañana (Anuncio Comercial)
prompts.text:
Dramatic freeze-frame of a basketball player releasing a three-point shot at the buzzer, team down by two, ball frozen inches from fingertips. Camera positioned courtside at shoulder height, 5 meters from shooter, angled slightly upward, telephoto compressing background crowd into a wall of energy.

The player is African American, late 20s, face showing supernatural focus — eyes locked on rim with tunnel vision, jaw clenched. Shooting form textbook perfect at moment of release: right arm extended with follow-through, wrist snapped, left guide hand separating from ball. Sweat droplets suspended in air catching arena lights. Jersey deep purple with gold trim, dark with sweat. Sneakers show court dust, legs at full extension.

The basketball is frozen 30cm from fingertips in perfect backspin, orange leather and black seams tack-sharp, NBA logo visible.

Background shows the stakes: scoreboard readable through bokeh displaying down by 2, 0.3 seconds remaining, GAME 7. 20,000 fans captured in motion blur with raised arms and open mouths. Hundreds of phone screens create blue-white rectangular bokeh. Opposing bench players frozen mid-rise.

The lighting is NBA arena configuration — powerful overhead arrays, follow-spots adding glamour rim lighting. Polished hardwood creates mirror-like secondary light from below.

Camera style: Sony A1 with 400mm f/2.8 at f/2.8. Shutter 1/4000s freezing all motion. Telephoto compression flattens crowd into solid wall.

Color grading: Broadcast-accurate arena colors — team purple and gold, parquet floor, accurate skin tones. High punchy contrast.

Composition: Shooter occupies left two-thirds, ball and arm creating line toward implied rim off-frame. Defender's hand entering from right. Scoreboard in upper background.

Mood & vibe: Unbearable tension, frozen time, career-defining. The photograph that defines a legacy.

Quality: 8K, extreme detail in expression, muscle, sweat droplets, ball texture, crowd energy.

Negative prompts: No cartoon, no CGI, no empty arena, no static crowd, no motion blur on player, no outdoor court, no posed shot.

prompts.text: Waist-up photo of a 30-year-old Italian-American woman sitting on the edge of a grey velvet sofa in a Hoboken apartment at 4:25pm. Fair olive skin with a natural sun flush across the cheeks, long dark-brown hair freshly air-dried in loose waves pulled off the face with a cream silk headband, small gold huggies, a single thin gold chain with a Saint Christopher pendant, a small diamond nose stud. A slim gold Michael Kors watch on the left wrist, a Cartier Love bracelet dupe in yellow gold, a stack of four thin gold rings, long square acrylics in a milky French. Sitting leaned slightly forward with both hands cupped around a tall clear glass of iced coffee with oat milk, condensation beading down the glass, straw angled toward the mouth, head tilted down, eyes lifting to meet the camera, lips closed around the straw mid-sip. Behind her: a low marble-topped coffee table with a Diptyque Baies candle burning, a folded NYT Sunday crossword half-done in pen, an AirPods Max in silver resting on the page, an empty Sweetgreen bowl with a fork still in it, a La Croix can; a tall ring light folded on a stand propped by the wall, a gold-framed mirror, a gallery wall of black-and-white family photos, a marble console with a tall monstera in a woven basket, a stainless KitchenAid just visible through a doorway, warm late-afternoon sun slanting across a parquet floor. Shot on iPhone 15 Pro rear camera, 26mm, warm late-afternoon golden window light from camera-right, natural bloom on the highlights. Skin: subtly highlighted cheekbones, visible peach fuzz along the jaw, a small healing blemish covered with a hydrocolloid dot on the temple, a faint sunburn across the tops of the shoulders, a beauty mark near the collarbone, slightly rough skin on the elbows. Color grade: warm cream-peach highlights, soft sage shadows, mild iPhone HDR glow, slight halation on the iced coffee glass.

prompts.title: Selfie Natural en Auto (Belleza & Glow)
prompts.text: Full-body candid of a 22-year-old Italian-American woman with shoulder-length jet-black hair and chunky face-framing layers, standing in front of the open glass-door beer-and-energy fridge of a New Jersey 7-Eleven at night. Hand resting on one hip, the other holding a cracked-open Celsius can angled toward the camera, head tilted slightly, one brow raised, lips parted in a half-smirk, a faint smudge of brown lipliner past the lip line. Tiny wording changes can completely transform how human a face looks, how skin reacts to light, and whether an image feels like a real photo or obvious AI. The cheat-sheet below shows you the small but powerful phrases that consistently push AI models toward **true photographic realism**, especially when generating people.

Use these as your foundation whenever you want faces, skin, and environments to feel like they were captured with a real camera, not generated by a computer.

Adding even minor changes to your prompts can make a massive difference. If you are struggling to get the outcome you want, try adding some from this cheat-sheet to help you out!

THE BEST MODEL FOR REALISTIC AVATARS IS **NANOBANANA PRO!**

prompts.text:
```

1️⃣ CORE PHOTOREALISM TRIGGERS (MOST IMPORTANT)

```

Always include at least 2–3 of these:

- photorealistic

- ultra-realistic

- real-world photography

- cinematic realism

- lifelike details

- natural imperfections

- true-to-life textures

- realistic skin / materials / surfaces

✅ Example:

"ultra-realistic cinematic photography with natural imperfections"

```

2️⃣ CAMERA & LENS WORDS (THIS MAKES OR BREAKS REALISM)

```

These words tell the AI this is a photo and not a fake image.

Camera Language

- DSLR photography

- mirrorless camera

- cinematic film still

- documentary-style photography

- street photography

- studio portrait photography

Lens & Optics

- 35mm lens (most natural realism)

- 50mm lens (human eye look)

- 85mm portrait lens (faces)

- shallow depth of field

- natural bokeh

- realistic focal length

✅ Example:

"shot on a 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural bokeh"

REMEMBER: ChatGPT can help you to craft your prompts! Send it your photo, and ask "this doesn't look real enough to me, can we add some more detail to the prompt?"

```

3️⃣ LIGHTING WORDS

```

Avoid fantasy lighting. Use real-world lighting terms:

- natural light

- soft window light

- golden hour sunlight

- overcast daylight

- practical lighting

- studio softbox lighting

- subtle rim light

- realistic shadows

❌ Avoid: neon glow, magical light, fantasy lighting (unless intentional)

✅ Example:

"soft natural daylight with realistic shadows"

Natural daylight is probably my most used phrase when prompting for realism. Daylight highlights all of the imperfections we have and creates an image that is how we see the world every day.

4️⃣ TEXTURE & DETAIL WORDS (IMPORTANT)

```

These prevent the plastic AI look even further:

- high-detail textures

- realistic surface detail

- visible pores

- fabric grain

- skin micro-details

- dust, scratches, wear

- slight imperfections

- tactile materials

✅ Example:

"visible skin pores, natural fabric grain, slight imperfections."

Imperfections is the big one! Unless you tell it not to, AI sometimes loves to make skin perfect and plastic, adding the small imperfections adds a level of realism that makes your avatars next level.

Then once you pair this with natural lighting etc, the whole image transforms.

```

5️⃣ COLOR & TONE CONTROL (REALISM = RESTRAINT)

```

Use controlled, photographic color language:

- natural color grading

- muted tones

- earthy color palette

- cinematic color balance

- realistic contrast

- soft highlights, deep shadows

❌ Avoid: hyper-saturated, neon, cartoon colors

```

6️⃣ COMPOSITION WORDS (think like a photographer)

```

These subtly push realism:

- rule of thirds

- eye-level shot

- candid moment

- unstaged composition

- natural framing

- foreground / background separation

```

7️⃣ GRAIN & IMAGE QUALITY (THE FINAL 10%)

```

These make more cinematic images feel captured instead of AI generated:

- subtle film grain

- cinematic grain

- high dynamic range (HDR, used lightly)

- sharp focus

- clean but not overly polished

```

8️⃣ NEGATIVE WORDS (CRITICAL)

```

Not getting the result you want? Add negatives to your prompts to protect realism:

Negative Prompt Essentials

- No cartoon style

- No CGI

- No 3D render

- No game engine

- No plastic skin

- No unrealistic lighting

- No text, logo, watermark

You'll end up with something like this:

"Ultra-realistic cinematic photography of a female model, shot on a 35mm lens, natural day time lighting, realistic shadows, shallow depth of field, true-to-life textures, visible imperfections, subtle film grain, natural color grading"

```

Then you just need to add the context of what you want.

The image exhibits authentic optical depth of field with natural lens falloff, subtle background bokeh, and gentle edge softness, while the main subject remains razor-sharp. Surfaces show real-world micro-texture including skin pores, fabric weave, dust, fingerprints, smudges, scratches, and slight wear — nothing looks airbrushed or artificially clean. Lighting behaves realistically with light wrap, bounce light, and soft ambient occlusion, producing dimensional depth and grounded presence. Color grading is neutral and photographic with true whites, natural skin tones, and slight warm daylight bias, avoiding oversaturation or artificial HDR. There is fine cinematic film grain and sensor noise in the shadows, preserving organic realism. Highlights roll off smoothly with no clipping, and blacks retain detail instead of crushing. The image looks like a high-end still frame from a real cinematic camera, not an illustration, render, or digital painting — it should be visually indistinguishable from real life photography. ⬇️
